relevance_note: The paper reports a family with succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase deficiency ('the diagnosis of SSADH-D was confirmed by genetic sequencing by a diagnostic company') and characterizes four ALDH5A1 variants (c.269T>C, p.Val90Ala; c.278C>T, p.Cys93Phe; c.538T>C, p.His180Tyr; c.763A>G, p.Asn255Asp).
method_note: Read only the paper, the schema and the rules; every value was copied by hand from the Markdown (no script was used). Tables 1 and 2 are oligonucleotide tables and contain no patients; the paper has no table with patients as rows or columns and no stacked ' / ' cells in patient data, so the v6 stacked-cell rule did not apply. Contradictions found in the paper: (1) Methods 4.1 prints 'c.278G>T, p.Cys93Phe' while Results and Figure 1 print c.278C>T for the same variant; (2) Methods 4.1 writes 'c.538T>C (paternal), p.His180Tyr' while Results and Figure 1 place His180Tyr on the maternally inherited allele; (3) the Introduction says 'Cys93Phe and Asn255Ala are pathogenic' although the variant is Asn255Asp everywhere else; (4) Asn255Asp is first reported as a variant of unknown significance (VUS) and later classified as pathogenic; (5) the Figure 4 and Figure 7 legends write 'Asn255Asp/His180Tyr' while the rest of the paper writes 'His180Tyr/Asn255Asp'. Decisions: His180Tyr and Asn255Asp are recorded as two separate variant rows per carrier even though the paper also describes them as one double variant in cis (Figure 9 itself is not visible in the Markdown). The treatments with arimoclomol, betaine and celastrol were applied to patient-derived fibroblasts in vitro, not to the patient, so treatment_summary is 'not reported'. The father is referred to only through the words 'The paternal variant' and is never described as a person or as tested, so he has no row; the patient's inheritance values rest on the paper's own paternal/maternal designation of the variants, no parental testing being reported. The previously published patient with p.Asn255Ser ('has already been described in an SSADH-D patient [15]') gets one row under the v4 rule because the paper gives that person's variant. The increased urine GHB was recorded as a patient-level finding, whereas the SSADH expression and activity data were obtained in cultured fibroblasts and were not recorded as features of a person. Variant class 'missense' was taken from the Methods sentence listing 'the SSADH missense variants Val90Ala, Cys93Phe; His180Tyr; Asn255Asp; and His180Tyr/Asn255Asp', which names each variant; pathogenicity values are the paper's per-variant statements (the double variant His180Tyr/Asn255Asp in cis is called pathogenic, while His180Tyr alone is called benign).
